description: Interactive SVG Layout Visual for Power BI allows you to transform any SVG design — such as site maps, floor plans, or custom layouts — into an interactive Power BI visual. This visual makes your dashboards more intuitive by turning visual elements into clickable areas that instantly filter and highlight related Power BI data. Key Features: Convert SVG layouts into interactive visuals with area-based filtering. Clickable zones to filter Power BI visuals dynamically by area, zone, or category. Instant integration — upload your SVG directly without external tools or Excel mapping. Live refresh — interact with your data in real time. Custom tooltips and hover effects for each zone or object. AI reporting support — automatically summarize performance, delay drivers, and changes in key data paths. Designed for: project managers, planners, data analysts, and dashboard designers who want to visualize spatial or layout-based data inside Power BI. Integration: The visual works seamlessly with all Power BI visuals and supports direct connections to project databases or structured datasets. Availability: Free to download. Advanced (Pro) features will be available in future versions via license key.
